messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH - model-inference-eu (latency spike > 500ms) // Page sent to #eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Sasha: seeing a bunch of 502s from the load-balancer, tailing logs now
Devon: on it, pulling pod logs and router metrics. SLA hit?
Mira: customer error reports coming in for batch inference jobs, marking impacted customers list (approx 6)
AJ: I'm standing up a short-lived canary cluster in us-west to try redirecting a small percentage of traffic, will report after 10m
Leah: ping @Sasha any obvious KV-cache evictions in recent deploy?
Sasha: no deploy in the last 2 hours. KV eviction rate spiked at 17:02 UTC, correlates with latency jump
ops-bot: Autoscaler scaled up 3 instances at 17:04 UTC but pods failed readiness on startup (CrashLoopBackOff)
Devon: logs show mismatch in model weights path after a recent artifact rotation, failing loads -> fallback to smaller model not wired for that route
Mira: escalation to infra? this explains customer-facing errors
AJ: rollback flag deployed to route-tier? can we fallback globally to trimmed-model-v2?
Sasha: pushing route override to fallback to trimmed-model-v2 now. Rolling back artifact rotation for model-prod-2026-03-14
pm-bot: deploy bot: rolled back artifact model-prod-2026-03-14 to model-prod-2026-03-13 (user: Sasha)
Sasha: fallback applied, latency dropping, errors trending down :thumbsup:
Devon: monitoring dashboards look good, will keep page open for 30m and validate no regression
Mira: creating initial incident doc and impact summary in the incidents tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3847 (draft)
Leah: quick customer outreach list: 6 customers, two enterprise with high SLA requirements. I've DM'd customer-success to start notifications
AJ: oncall handoff in 20m — leaving mitigation stable, shifting to monitoring-only
Sasha: handing off to Devon for post-incident follow-up and postmortem scheduling
Devon: ack. scheduling post-incident review. Proposed: tomorrow 15:00 UTC, 60m. Would prefer if product & infra attend (Mira, Leah, infra leads)
Mira: works for me. I'll add affected-customer reps and CS. Also attaching the impact snapshot and earliest root cause notes to the ticket
Leah: from a prioritization POV, this is P1 -> action items need sizing. Suggest action list: 1) artifact rotation validation hooks (owner: Mira) 2) add model-load integration tests in runtime CI (owner: Sasha) 3) graceful fallback wiring for route-tier to trimmed models (owner: AJ) 4) autoscaler readiness tuning (owner: infra)
Devon: adding estimates: 1) Mira - 3d (investigation + infra change) 2) Sasha - 2d (tests + infra flip) 3) AJ - 1d (config + smoke) 4) infra - 2d (tuning + deploy)
Mira: agree with sizing but propose we split 1) into quick safety gate (1d) + full validation (3d) — quick gate is high priority for Q1 remediation list
Leah: we should tag tasks with quarterly tie-ins. Quick safety gate -> Q1 urgent. Full validation + CI tests -> Q2 API reliability epic. Autoscaler tuning -> Q1 ops backlog
Devon: next steps: create JIRA subtasks under INC-3847, link to the postmortem, set severity=P1, assign owners, add estimates. I'll create the tickets after this thread and post links
Sasha: also add a regression monitor: a.k.a. alert when artifact rotation occurs without checksum verification. Owner: Sasha, estimate 1d
Mira: scheduling note for postmortem: agenda = timeline / root cause / action items + owners + verification criteria. We'll do VC recording and an outcomes doc in the incident ticket
Leah: for prioritization, recommend we attach at least one measurable verification per action (e.g., integration tests + gating rule, smoke test passing for 10 sequential deploys)
Devon: agreed. I'll add verification criteria to each Jira subtask. Also I'll request 0.5 FTE in the next sprint for Sasha's work to unblock faster
ops-bot: Reminder: page is still active; if status = mitigated please post final closure note
AJ: monitoring is green for 22m. I'm marking mitigated in the on-call rotation UI, leaving postmortem tasks to owners
Sasha: final note: customers got short-lived errors ~15m, no data loss, CS already sent initial outreach. Good recovery but need to close the action items quickly
Devon: created subtasks: INC-3847-1 (safety gate) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3847-1, INC-3847-2 (runtime CI tests) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3847-2, INC-3847-3 (fallback wiring) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3847-3, INC-3847-4 (autoscaler tuning) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3847-4
Mira: I'll lead the postmortem doc draft, target ready for review in 48h
Leah: I'll own customer verification and SLA follow-up, estimate 2d to close all outreach tasks
Devon: Action owners: Mira(lead doc + safety gate 1d), Sasha(runtime tests + regression monitor 3d), AJ(fallback wiring 1d), infra (autoscaler tuning 2d), Leah(customer follow-up 2d). Priorities: safety gate & customer comms -> P0 for this sprint; CI tests & autoscaler -> P1 and tied to Q2 reliability epic
Sasha: thanks all. Postmortem invite sent for tomorrow 15:00 UTC. See you there
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: model-inference-eu latency spike mitigated, incident archived as INC-3847 (status: mitigated -> postmortem scheduled)
Devon: closing thread, will update tickets with verifications when done
